verdict.rationale: OCI documents IAM policies that govern access to resources in a tenancy, which provides scoping. It also documents token-based authentication for the CLI as an alternative to keypairs, which hints at short-lived credentials. Neither is documented as a pattern for handing an agent narrowly-scoped credentials. Missing for 10: agent- or workload-specific credential guidance, explicit documentation of temporary or expiring credentials, scoping a token to least privilege, controls that prevent privilege escalation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
